description_en: The origin of this Śiva temple remains elusive, given the lack of historical records. As its specific name is not known, it is simply referred to asśivālaya(lit. the abode of Śiva) for the purpose of this documentation.The temple stands in the Pandhra Śivālaya complex on the eastern bank of the Bagmati river, opposite the cremation grounds. While the complex comprises fifteen similar shrines dedicated to Śiva, all linked to Jaṅga Bahādura Rāṇā, thisśivālaya, too, was probably built by a member of the Rāṇā clan. The temple is not officially part of the Pandhra Śivālaya ensemble despite being within its precincts.Made from bricks, a dome-style roof adorned with a metallic finial surmounts the temple. Latticed windows embellish the west, north, and east walls, while the entrance to the sanctum in the south is marked by a stone archway (toraṇa) featuring a central carving of Chepu, a mythical water creature.Within the sanctum, a central stoneśivaliṅgaassumes the role of the main deity. However, the shaft of theśivaliṅgais no longer intact. Additionally, the statue of Kāmadeva, positioned east of the temple, has been pilfered. Anotherśivaliṅgais located north of the temple, referred to as Dokheśvara by G. Ṭaṇḍana (VS 2056, p. 735) and Ḍhokeśvara by Michaels and Tandon (2017, p. 62).Lacking inscriptions at the site, the identity of the donor and the year of the temple’s construction remain unknown. Despite the uncertainty surrounding its origins, the architectural characteristics suggest a construction date during the Rāṇā period (1846-1951 CE).A Rājopādhyāya priest was appointed to oversee the temple, yet all daily and other rituals at the temple have ceased (Vīramadhuprakāśevara Temple priest, Ghimire, male, age 55).
description_ne: निर्माणमिति र निर्माताको बारे जानकारी दिने ऐतिहासिक अभिलेख नपाइएको यस शिवालयमा राजोपाध्याय ब्राह्मणलाई पुजारीको रूपमा नियुक्त गरिएको भएपनि नित्यपूजा बन्द भइसकेको छ ।पशुपति क्षेत्रमा रहेको पन्ध्रशिवालय परिसरमा यो शिवालय निर्माण गरिएको छ । गुम्बज शैलीको यो शिवालयमा धातुको गजूर राखिएको छ । इँटा प्रयोग गरी बनाइएको यस शिवालयको पश्चिम, उत्तर र पूर्वपट्टिको भित्तामा तिकिझ्या: बनाइएका छन् । यो शिवालयको प्रवेशद्वार दक्षिणपट्टि रहेको छ । प्रवेशद्वारमाथि छेपु अङ्कित ढुङ्गाको तोरण राखिएको छ । शिवालयको गर्भगृहभित्र शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरिएको छ । शिवलिङ्गमा रहेको लिङ्ग हराइसकेको छ । शिवालयको पूर्वमा स्थापना गरिएको कामदेवको मूर्ति चोरी भइसकेको छ । शिवालयको उत्तरमा एउटा शिवलिङ्ग स्थापना गरिएको छ । G. Ṭaṇḍana (VS 2056, p.735) ले उक्त शिवलिङ्गलाई दोखेश्वर भनेका छन् भने Michaels and Tandon (2017, p.62) ले ढोकेश्वर भनेका छन् ।यो शिवालयमा कुनै अभिलेख राखिएको पाइँदैन । त्यसैले यो शिवालय कसले र कहिले बनाएको थियो भन्ने कुरा थाहा पाइँदैन । शैलीको आधारमा यो शिवालय राणाकालमा निर्माण गरिएको देखिन्छ ।यस शिवालयमा राजोपाध्याय ब्राह्मणलाई पुजारीको रूपमा नियुक्त गरिएको भएपनि नित्यपूजा लगायत अन्य सबै पूजाहरू बन्द भइसकेका छन् (Priest of the Vīramadhuprakāśevara from a Ghimire caste, male, age 55) ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
references: REFERENCES Michaels, Axel, and Govinda Tandon. Paśupatikṣetra: A Historical Inventory . Kathmandu: Himal Books, 2017. Ṭaṇḍana, Govinda. Paśupatikṣetrako Sāṃskṛtika Adhyayana (Abhilekha Khaṇḍa) . Vol. 2. 2 vols. Kathmandu: Jharendra Śamśera Ja. Ba. Ra. and Mañju Rāṇā, 2056.
